controls.name: C1_sweep_is_four_sided
controls.must_fire_because: an inert sweep and a clean tree are indistinguishable (H124), so the instrument must produce BOTH verdicts on a constructed fixture, in the FILE shape and the DIRECTORY shape
controls.can_fail_because: the fixture tracked file or tracked directory is flagged, or either untracked case is not; every one of these was killed by a mutation before shipping
controls.null_must_contain: a tracked dependency and a tracked DIRECTORY, both of which the first version of this scan flagged

controls.name: C3_ignored_is_separated_from_untracked
controls.must_fire_because: a gitignored dep is a DECLARED absence; conflating it with an undeclared one inflates the rate F2 is decided on

controls.null_must_contain: at least one gitignored path, which this tree has by construction (`elders/`, `.scratch/`)

controls.must_fire_because: I claim v1 of this module mis-classified deps because `git check-ignore --stdin` aborted on a submodule path and its return code was never read; that claim needs its own observation
controls.can_fail_because: v1_rc in (0,1) and v1_missed == 0, i.e. the batch form never truncated and this whole repair is noise
controls.null_must_contain: agreement -- if git had exited 0/1 over the whole set, v1 and v2 would name the same ignored paths and v1 numbers would have stood
